scope_evolution.headline: The small vision did not sprawl incoherently and did not stay singular — it branched into a few coherent phyla. Reading the ancestral-core spine by hand: GP-023→GP-035→GP-037 is a genuine depth-3 refinement chain (gap-found→primitive-built→verifier-built) with NO parent: metadata, so the deterministic 'orphan dust = sprawl' verdict was an extraction artifact, not the truth.
scope_evolution.detail: Probe (5 cores + chain, ex-post semantic, GP-237 v2): the cores are different KINDS of root — substrate-program (GP-023), measurement-protocol (GP-072), verification-pipeline (GP-088). So: structured branching into ~3 coherent lineages, each speciating — not architecture-inflation, not one vision deepened. The real risk surfaced is a RECORDING-discipline gap, not incoherence: lineage exists but is not written as metadata (~85% of seams), and ids drift (GP-088 file ↔ '# GP-081' H1). Per recursive_over_architecting: the architecture grew coherently in places but WITHOUT lineage discipline, so the apparatus cannot see its own coherence — that is the actionable finding, not a sprawl score.

p0.headline: Positive at the discipline level, honestly flat-to-stuck at the science level — and the apparatus, not the operator, now carries self-correction.
p0.detail: What's real: the instrument catches its own laundering autonomously — Meta-Darwin + audit agents diagnosed 142 of the catches (the NS W6 and v30/GP-225 demolitions), the operator only 5. Calibration is net-positive on signals with real denominators (forecast externalities 211:95 ≈2.5:1; cross-family disagreement low and mostly resolved; Brier 0.16 < 0.25 this period). What's honestly flat/stuck: insight density plateaued and then dipped (contextualized taste sits ~1.2–1.3 latest, off a 3.11 peak, no paradigm-shifters); the hard-math frontier did not move (NS strict-margin atom open, gravity unearned, neural law failed); the one Goodhart-resistant metric (external validation) is not yet a number. Net: the defensible claim is the apparatus and its autonomous self-correction — NOT a scientific result. Calling the whole thing 'good progress this week' would be the narrative-inflation this page exists to catch (the #1 catch category).

bifurcation.headline: ~63% of this week's authored work happened out-of-loop (~80% cumulative). The ZTARE iteration loop is a minority substrate — the live work is RD/agent dispatch + governance + mining. In-loop = the iter** work files themselves, not project-dir membership.
bifurcation.detail: This is the central finding: the apparatus runs almost entirely outside its own evolutionary loop, by design and by measurement.

sophistication.headline: Do NOT read the rising blue line as progress — it is CUMULATIVE capability (82→1453); a cumulative count only ever goes up. The orange bars (Soph-D) count ZTARE iter-loop cage engagements only — they read ~20 because the iter-loop / VPS cognitive-firm workers were not run this week, NOT because autonomy fell. The real autonomous activity (RD/agent dispatch, ~20,500 out-of-loop artifacts this week) is in the Bifurcation panel; Soph-D mismeasures autonomy and should not be read as a P0 metric.
